metadata.title: NewLabEnvironment
metadata.description: This module lets you roll out your lab environment automatically as described in our blogs (www.365dude.nl and www.svenvanrijen.nl) or the GitHub repo of the module (https://github.com/ralpje/PowerShell-Lab-Module).

findings.title: Network retrieval combined with code execution
findings.description: The same file contains both a network retrieval pattern and a dynamic execution pattern. This combination merits review and is not by itself proof of malicious intent.
